meanings.note: large amount of money or property

examples.text: Я потерял абсолютно всё своё богатство.
examples.trans: I lost absolutely all my wealth.

examples.text: Главное богатство страны — это её люди.
examples.trans: The main wealth of the country is its people.

meanings.note: бывший мэр = the former mayor; бывшая жена = ex-wife

examples.trans: I grew up in a communal flat.

вернуть.gloss: to give back, to get back

выдать.gloss: to issue, give out, hand out

examples.trans: The cashier issued the money against the receipt.

meanings.note: usually the short form: я готов (m), я готова (f)
на днях = in the next few days, or the other day

examples.trans: I'll call in the next few days.

meanings.en: to wait until, await, live to see

examples.text: Я готов спокойно дождаться решения суда.
examples.trans: I am ready to wait calmly for the court decision.

examples.text: Мы дождались прихода поезда на станцию.
examples.trans: We waited for the train's arrival at the station.

meanings.note: думать о + prepositional = to think about

examples.trans: I have no time to think about that.
I live in a communal flat.

meanings.note: to run for a second term

examples.trans: He is running for a second term.

meanings.note: как вы знаете = as you know

examples.trans: It's easy for you to say.

meanings.note: в любой момент = at any moment
на его место = in his place

examples.trans: He is the mayor of the town.

начаться.gloss: to begin, to start, to break out

meanings.en: to begin, to start, to break out (intransitive)

examples.trans: The film started at seven sharp.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates
hesitation, at the start of a sentence
agrees in gender and case with the noun
оставь мне кусок = save me a piece

examples.trans: I won't leave him on his own.

отдыхать.gloss: to rest, to relax, to vacation

meanings.en: to rest, to take a break

examples.text: Вы отдыхайте, а мы сами поедем.
examples.trans: You rest, and we'll go ourselves.

meanings.en: to get used to, grow accustomed to

examples.trans: Get used to your new life.
A person quickly gets used to good things.

meanings.en: to have to, to be forced to
meanings.note: impersonal with dative: мне придётся = I'll have to

examples.trans: I'm going to have to torture you.
We had to wait a long time.
I am forced to cancel my decision.

meanings.note: + instrumental; со before some consonant clusters: со всеми
сбежать из-под ареста = to escape house arrest

examples.text: Да, он сбежал, чтобы спасти моего ребёнка.
examples.trans: Yes, he escaped custody to save my child.
The prisoner escaped from prison at night.

meanings.note: refers back to the subject: 'он держит своё слово' = he keeps his word

examples.trans: The seller returned the extra change to the buyer.

meanings.note: 'дать слово' = to give one's word, 'держать слово' = to keep one's word
next door, or in the same flat

examples.trans: That's a nightmare, I don't argue.
The people are interested in his fate.

examples.text: Я бы на твоём месте подумал.
examples.trans: If I were you, I'd think about it.

meanings.note: a bit formal; 'биржа труда' = job centre

examples.trans: The job centre is over there.

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

meanings.note: уже четыре года = for four years now

examples.text: Я уже четыре года работаю мэром.
examples.trans: I've been mayor for four years now.

examples.text: Ты же у нас такая умная!

examples.trans: If you don't want to, suit yourself.

meanings.note: points at something: это моё = that's mine

meanings.en: other forms: этого, этому, это, этим, этом

examples.trans: I'm sick of this communal flat.

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
